title: Sherpa Voice diarization UI validation with bundled multi-speaker turns
description: Downloads the English speaker embedding model if needed, opens the existing Speaker Diarization page, initializes pyannote + campplus, runs the bundled alternating JFK/English sample, and asserts native diarization returns speaker segments.

ensure-speaker-id-model.description: download speaker-id-en-voxceleb if not already present
ensure-speaker-id-model.expression: (function(){var A=globalThis.__AGENTIC__;var MODEL='speaker-id-en-voxceleb';if(!A||!A.downloadModel||!A.getState){return Promise.resolve({status:'error',error:'agentic bridge missing'});}function modelStatus(){var s=(A.getState().models||{}).statuses||{};return (s[MODEL]||{}).status||'unknown';}if(modelStatus()==='downloaded'){return Promise.resolve({status:'success',already:true});}try{A.downloadModel(MODEL);}catch(e){}return new Promise(function(resolve){var i=0;function tick(){var st=modelStatus();if(st==='downloaded'){resolve({status:'success',already:false});return;}if(st==='error'){resolve({status:'error',lastStatus:st});return;}i++;if(i>=900){resolve({status:'timeout',lastStatus:st});return;}setTimeout(tick,1000);}tick();});})()
